intent: Showcase the existing local-settings statement as the focal point and saved-preferences copy as secondary emphasis. App.tsx provides these claims in Included features; the Save button has no persistence handler, so no additional storage or export capability is claimed. Use still, seeded marks attached to existing paragraphs; conditionally mount them with enabled so the React adapter destroys overlays on disable or App unmount. Existing text conveys all meaning without additional narration.

targets.description: Unique Included features paragraph: Settings stay on this device. Attach localFeatureRef to this existing paragraph.

Unique Included features paragraph: Use Save settings to keep your preferences. Despite its ID, this is saved-preferences copy, not evidence of export. Attach savedPreferencesRef to this existing paragraph.
